name: みみもとVR – ASMRビジュアライザー
summary:
Mimimoto VR is an ASMR visualizer for Meta Quest. Play the ASMR audio you already love, and a character appears beside you in VR, moving with the sound.

The app analyzes the left and right channels to tell voices, breaths, and ear-cleaning sounds apart, then turns them into motion: leaning toward the ear the sound comes from, moving closer, hand movements, ear blowing, lip movement, and facial expressions.

■ Three poses ・Lean-over: lie down facing up. The character leans over you and whispers into either
